marta: Heads-up: finance ops flagged PO 987654321 stuck in PENDING_LEDGER_SYNC after an Azure Marketplace accept. vendor_uuid was null on our side. Can eng + marketplace ops triage?

raj: cc @oliver @sasha. saw similar where cross-listed sellers TTL out of our vendor-mapping cache. ack comes after eviction -> vendor_not_found.

oliver: i'll grab the accept logs now. if the mapping service evicted the row during the accept window we'll see vendor_uuid:null and marketplace 404.

sasha: filing with Azure now, case AZ-98377. they asked for raw accept payload + exact timestamps. sending.

marta: finance says customer was charged but the ledger entry never reconciled, so revenue recognition is blocked until ledger attach. legal also flagged a signatory mismatch for the seller entity on this cross-listing. could require a manual signed attestation.

dani-legal: if signatory differs, we need either an MSA amendment or a one-time signed attestation. I can accept attestation PDF to unblock billing; finance must confirm treatment.

finance-bot: alert: PO 987654321 -> PENDING_LEDGER_SYNC. reason: vendor_lookup_failed.

oliver: logs snippet:
```
{"event":"ack_receive","po_id":"987654321","vendor_uuid":null,"marketplace_response":{"code":404,"error":"vendor_not_found"}}
```

raj: short-term mitigation: extend vendor-mapping cache TTL from 15m -> 24h for records flagged cross-listed, and add a reconciliation worker that retries vendor_lookup for PENDING_LEDGER_SYNC POs for up to 12h. low-impact change but needs a config rollout + canary.

marta: can we manually fix this PO now? finance ops can accept a manual ledger entry if legal provides attestation.

dani-legal: i can get the attestation signed today if partnerships does outreach. who owns contacting the seller?

sasha: i'll email the seller and attach the attestation template. ETA ~4h. updating AZ case with the plan and logs.

oliver: after attestation we can run one-off ledger attach: `./tools/ledger_attach --po 987654321 --vendor-uuid <uuid>` i'll run it after legal confirmation. i'll also enqueue the reconciliation worker.

raj: i'll open a PR for TTL bump + reconciliation worker, tag eng-releases for a small canary. estimate 2 days to test + deploy.

marta: plan recap: 1) @sasha outreach to seller + attestation (ETA 4h) 2) @dani-legal review sig + ok 3) @oliver run ledger_attach and confirm ledger sync 4) @raj ship TTL + reconciliation (2d) 5) @sasha push Azure case if AZ-98377 stalls. finance to confirm revenue treatment once ledger attached.

sasha: outreach sent. included attestation template and request for scanned signature. linked AZ case.

oliver: ops playbook note: when you see vendor_lookup_failed on cross-listed PO, add tag `crosslist-ttl-stick` and notify eng-oncall.

marta: thanks all, marking escalation. will follow up after attestation arrives. :thumbsup:
